register.reg_long_name: Performance Monitors Count Enable Set register
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_AA32 is implemented and FEAT_PMUv3 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Allows software to enable the following counters:
Reading from this register shows which counters are enabled.

field_description.para: PMCCNTR enable. On writes, allows software to enable PMCCNTR. On reads, returns the PMCCNTR enable status.

field_access_level.field_access_sublevel: EL0 is the current Exception level
EL0 is the current Exception level

field_description.para: PMEVCNTR<m> enable. On writes, allows software to enable PMEVCNTR<m>. On reads, returns the PMEVCNTR<m> enable status.

field_access_level.field_access_sublevel: EL0 is the current Exception level
EL0 is the current Exception level
